question: Where are a hospital located within an 80 kilometers range toward the east of Steinhart Aquarium, CA?
sql: SELECT id, poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Steinhart Aquarium%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 80000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Steinhart Aquarium%' LIMIT 1 ) ), ST_Centroid(p.geometry) ) ) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
